tools.name: gv_list_pages
tools.description: Lists every informational route on growthvector.io with title, description, and section. Never a page-limited subset.

tools.name: gv_get_page
tools.description: Returns the complete text of one GrowthVector page with its headings. A page longer than 40,000 characters comes in numbered parts: the result names the part, totalParts, and nextPart. Call again with part = nextPart until nextPart is null to read the whole page. Nothing is left out.

tools.name: gv_search_site
tools.description: Hybrid retrieval over GrowthVector's guides, glossary, prompt library, and reference documents. Returns ranked results with the FULL chunk text, title, heading path, URL, and score. Search first, then call gv_get_page on a page result's route (sourceType page) for the complete page. Cite the page UR

tools.name: gv_lookup_term
tools.description: Returns the definition of a digital marketing glossary term from the site glossary.

tools.name: gv_list_prompts
tools.description: Lists every prompt in the canonical prompt library with id, category, and title.

tools.name: gv_get_prompt
tools.description: Returns a prompt from the library exactly as written, never summarized.

tools.name: gv_site_facts
tools.description: Current pricing labels, product SKUs, tool quota limits, and contact details from the live billing catalog.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "gv_search_site" is 627 chars, far longer than this server's median (107). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "gv_search_site" stacks urgency/override words (important, never, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
